cohort: 50 pregnant patients at VIMSAR Burla, India
finding: Subclinical hypothyroidism was associated with maternal complications (preeclampsia, preterm labor, postpartum hemorrhage) and neonatal complications (low birth weight, intrauterine growth retardation, poor APGAR score, RDS, and perinatal deaths).
followup_time: Until delivery and the perinatal period
birth_weight: Low birth weight (specific values not provided)
